---
title: "Benchmarking"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mgcv)
library(purrr)
library(multcompView)



input_dir="/.../"
output_dir="/.../"
```

Quantify confident calls
```{r}
# 90X = gold standard - create it first by intersecting all 3 seeds
df_90X <- lapply(1:3, function(s) {
  readRDS(paste0(input_dir, "sample_control_90X-seed", s, "-RB17-6_HSC_G1_vs_sample_control_RB17-6_Tail_filtered.rds")) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% .[, c(1,2,4,5)]
})

gold_90X <- Reduce(dplyr::intersect, df_90X)
saveRDS(gold_90X, file = paste0(output_dir, "golden_variant_list_90X_inter.rds"))

# For all other coverages, intersect each seed against the gold standard
coverages <- c(80, 70, 60, 50, 40, 30, 20, 10)

for (cov in coverages) {
  for (s in 1:3) {
    df <- readRDS(paste0(input_dir, "sample_control_", cov, "X-seed", s, 
                         "_RB17-6_HSC_G1_vs_sample_control_RB17-6_Tail_filtered.rds")) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>% .[, c(1,2,4,5)]
    
    overlap <- dplyr::intersect(gold_90X, df)
    saveRDS(overlap, file = paste0(output_dir, "/", cov, "X/overlap_", cov, "X_", s, "_vs_gold_90X.rds"))
  }
}
```

Plot
```{r}
plot_dir="/.../"

#Plot 1: plot the number of variants per coverage
benchmark <- do.call(rbind, lapply(coverages, function(cov) {
  if (cov == 90) {
    # gold standard: single intersection file
    n <- nrow(readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "golden_variant_list_90X_inter.rds")))
    data.frame(Coverage = paste0(cov, "X"), No_of_called_variants = n)
  } else {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(1:3, function(s) {
      n <- nrow(readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "/", cov, "X/overlap_", cov, "X_", s, "_vs_gold_90X.rds")))
      data.frame(Coverage = paste0(cov, "X"), No_of_called_variants = n)
    }))
  }
}))

benchmark$Coverage <- factor(benchmark$Coverage, levels = paste0(coverages, "X"))

caveman_no_variants<-ggplot(benchmark, aes(x=Coverage, y=No_of_called_variants)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill="#1982C4")+
  geom_point()+
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "#1BE7FF", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "#1BE7FF", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=18)+
  ylim(50, 170)


pdf(file=paste0(plot_dir, "number_of_variants_filtered_per_coverage_CAVEMAN_corrected.pdf"), width = 5, height = 4)
caveman_no_variants
dev.off()

#Plot 2: percentage of overlapping variants with the gold_90X.
gold_count <- nrow(gold_90X)

benchmark$overlap <- do.call(c, lapply(coverages, function(cov) {
  if (cov == 90) {
    nrow(readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "golden_variant_list_90X_inter.rds")))
  } else {
    sapply(1:3, function(s) {
      nrow(readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "/", cov, "X/overlap_", cov, "X_", s, "_vs_gold_90X.rds")))
    })
  }
}))


benchmark$percentage_of_overlap <- benchmark$overlap * 100 / gold_count
saveRDS(benchmark, paste0(plot_dir, "benchmark_summary_CAVEMAN_corrected.rds"))

caveman_perc_overlap<-ggplot(benchmark, aes(x=Coverage, y=percentage_of_overlap)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill="#32A287")+
  geom_point()+
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "#40F99B", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "#40F99B", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=16)+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,100,10))


pdf(file=paste0(plot_dir, "perc_of_overlap_per_coverage_CAVEMAN_corrected.pdf"), width = 5.5, height = 4)
caveman_perc_overlap
dev.off()
```

Stats:
```{r}
anova_caveman_number_of_variants<- aov(No_of_called_variants ~ Coverage, data = benchmark)
tukey_variants <- TukeyHSD(anova_caveman_number_of_variants)
print(tukey_variants)

anova_caveman_overlap<- aov(percentage_of_overlap ~ Coverage, data = benchmark)
tukey_overlap <- TukeyHSD(anova_caveman_overlap)
print(tukey_overlap)


benchmark <- na.omit(benchmark)
benchmark$depth_numeric <- as.numeric(gsub("X", "", benchmark$Coverage))
loess_fit_caveman <- loess(No_of_called_variants ~ depth_numeric, data = benchmark, span = 0.75)

depth_seq_caveman <- seq(min(benchmark$depth_numeric), max(benchmark$depth_numeric), length.out = 100)
predicted_caveman <- predict(loess_fit_caveman, newdata = data.frame(depth_numeric = depth_seq_caveman))

##check how it looks
ggplot(benchmark, aes(x = depth_numeric, y = No_of_called_variants)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(depth_numeric = depth_seq_caveman, fitted = predicted_caveman),
            aes(x = depth_numeric, y = fitted), color = "blue", size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  xlab("Coverage (X)") +
  ylab("No. of Called Variants")


#####What is the right span value ?
spans<-seq(0.2, 1.5, by=0.05)

# Define LOOCV function (Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation)
loocv_error <- function(span_val) {
  preds <- rep(NA, nrow(caveman))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(caveman))) {
    train <- caveman[-i, ]
    test  <- caveman[i, ]
    
    model <- try(loess(No_of_called_variants ~ depth_numeric, data = train, span = span_val), silent = TRUE)
    
    if (!inherits(model, "try-error")) {
      preds[i] <- predict(model, newdata = test)
    }
  }
  
  mean((caveman$No_of_called_variants - preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
}

###Evaluate the error for each span
cv_results <- tibble(
  span = spans,
  mse = map_dbl(spans, loocv_error)
)

# Plot CV error vs span
pdf(file="/.../LOOCV_for_LOESS_Caveman_No_of_variants.pdf", width = 5.5, height = 4)
ggplot(cv_results, aes(x = span, y = mse)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "LOOCV: Choosing Optimal LOESS Span",
       x = "Span", y = "Mean Squared Error")
dev.off()

# Best span
best_span <- cv_results$span[which.min(cv_results$mse)] ###the value is 0.45


###Continue with span = 0.45
loess_fit_caveman_optim <- loess(No_of_called_variants ~ depth_numeric, data = caveman, span = 0.45)
depth_seq_caveman_optim <- seq(min(caveman$depth_numeric), max(caveman$depth_numeric), length.out = 100)
predicted_caveman_optim <- predict(loess_fit_caveman_optim, newdata = data.frame(depth_numeric = depth_seq_caveman), se=TRUE)

loess_df_caveman <- data.frame(
  depth_numeric = depth_seq_caveman_optim,
  fit = predicted_caveman_optim$fit,
  se = predicted_caveman_optim$se.fit
)

# Add upper and lower bounds (approx 95% CI)
loess_df_caveman$lower <- loess_df_caveman$fit - 1.96 * loess_df_caveman$se
loess_df_caveman$upper <- loess_df_caveman$fit + 1.96 * loess_df_caveman$se


pdf(file="/.../LOESS_Caveman_No_of_variants.pdf", width = 5.5, height = 4)
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = caveman, mapping = aes(x = depth_numeric, y = No_of_called_variants), size = 2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = loess_df_caveman, mapping = aes(x = depth_numeric, ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "#1BE7FF") +
  geom_line(data = loess_df_caveman, mapping = aes(x = depth_numeric, y = fit), 
            color = "#1982C4", size = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 89)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  xlab("Coverage (X)") +
  ylab("No. of Called Variants")
dev.off()


##Check if the curve is significant
gam_model_caveman_vars <- gam(No_of_called_variants ~ s(depth_numeric, k=5), data = benchmark)
length(unique(benchmark$depth_numeric))
summary(gam_model_caveman_vars)$s.table[1, "p-value"]


#######Do the same for percentage overlap in caveman
loess_fit_caveman_overlap <- loess(percentage_of_overlap ~ depth_numeric, data = benchmark, span = 0.75)
depth_seq_caveman_overlap <- seq(min(benchmark$depth_numeric), max(benchmark$depth_numeric), length.out = 100)
predicted_caveman_overlap <- predict(loess_fit_caveman_overlap, newdata = data.frame(depth_numeric = depth_seq_caveman_overlap))


##check how it looks
ggplot(benchmark, aes(x = depth_numeric, y = percentage_of_overlap)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(depth_numeric = depth_seq_caveman_overlap, fitted = predicted_caveman_overlap),
            aes(x = depth_numeric, y = fitted), color = "blue", size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  xlab("Coverage (X)") +
  ylab("% of overlap")



spans<-seq(0.2, 1.5, by=0.05)


###Evaluate the error for each span and plot CV
cv_results <- tibble(
  span = spans,
  mse = map_dbl(spans, loocv_error)
)

pdf(file="/.../LOOCV_for_LOESS_Caveman_overlap.pdf", width = 5.5, height = 4)
ggplot(cv_results, aes(x = span, y = mse)) +

       x = "Span", y = "Mean Squared Error")
dev.off()

#Best span
best_span <- cv_results$span[which.min(cv_results$mse)] ###the value is 0.45 again
loess_fit_caveman_overlap <- loess(percentage_of_overlap ~ depth_numeric, data = benchmark, span = 0.45)
depth_seq_caveman_overlap <- seq(min(benchmark$depth_numeric), max(benchmark$depth_numeric), length.out = 100)

loess_df_caveman_overlap <- data.frame(
  depth_numeric = depth_seq_caveman_overlap,
  fit = predicted_caveman_overlap$fit,

)

# Add upper and lower bounds (approx 95% CI)
loess_df_caveman_overlap$lower <- loess_df_caveman_overlap$fit - 1.96 * loess_df_caveman_overlap$se
loess_df_caveman_overlap$upper <- loess_df_caveman_overlap$fit + 1.96 * loess_df_caveman_overlap$se


pdf(file="/.../LOESS_Caveman_percentage_overlap_09-06-2025.pdf", width = 5.5, height = 4)
ggplot() +

  geom_ribbon(data = loess_df_caveman_overlap, mapping = aes(x = depth_numeric, ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "#40F99B") +
  geom_line(data = loess_df_caveman_overlap, mapping = aes(x = depth_numeric, y = fit), 
            color = "#32A287", size = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 89)) +
  theme_minimal() +

  ylab("% of overlap")
dev.off()


##Check if the curve is significant
gam_model_caveman_overlap <- gam(percentage_of_overlap ~ s(depth_numeric, k=5), data = caveman)
length(unique(caveman$depth_numeric))
```
